name: Has Suit Modification
description: Checks whether the entity wears a complete Palladium suit with the given Tech Table modification installed on every piece. Optionally only for one suit set.

fields.description: The id of the suit modification (the file name under data/<namespace>/argon/suit_modification/).
The id of a Palladium suit set the worn suit has to be; any suit when left out.
Check the item worn or held in this slot instead of a suit (for modules installed on a device item in the Modify tab).
For modules that can be installed several times: the lowest level that counts.

name: Is in Rain
description: Checks if the entity is currently in rain.

name: Y Level
description: Checks if the user is currently at or above a specified Y level.

fields.description: The minimum Y coordinate the user must be at or above.

name: Danger Sense Count
description: Checks how many dangers the user's enabled argon:danger_sense ability is currently detecting (the largest count if there are several), for example to trigger an overload once enough threats are around.

fields.description: The fewest detected dangers that still pass.
The most detected dangers that still pass.

name: Any Animation Finished
description: Checks if any animation has finished in the current animation controller. Note: this condition is only effective when used inside an animation controller.

name: Team
description: Checks the team properties of the entity. Leave all other fields out to check just if the entity belongs to a team.

fields.description: Checks the name of the team.
Checks if the team allows friendly fire.
Checks if teammates can see invisible teammates.
Checks the nametag visibility rule of the team.
Checks the death message visibility rule of the team.
Checks the collision rule of the team.
Checks the color of the team.

name: Number Data Attachment
description: Checks if the value a number data attachment is within a given range.

fields.description: The ID of the data attachment.
The minimum required value of the data attachment.
The maximum required value of the data attachment.

name: Size
description: Checks if the entity's size is within the given range. If a size change type is specified, checks that type's specific modifier value instead of the overall size.

fields.description: The size change type whose modifier to check. If omitted, the overall current size is checked.
The minimum required size (inclusive).
The maximum required size (inclusive).

name: Health
description: Checks if the user's current health, as a percentage of their current max health (accounting for any active max-health modifiers), is between min and max (inclusive).

fields.description: The minimum health percentage required (0-100).
The maximum health percentage allowed (0-100).

name: Ability on Last Tick
description: Checks if the ability was just on its last tick.

fields.description: The ability that needs to be on its last tick.

name: Falling
description: Checks whether the user is airborne and moving downward, meaning not on the ground and not currently ascending.

name: Mod loaded
description: Checks if the specified mod was loaded into the game.

fields.description: The mod id that is being looked for.

name: Has Item
description: Checks whether the user possesses at least one matching item anywhere on them, including inventory, worn equipment, and Curios slots where applicable.

fields.description: The item(s) to search for, given as explicit item IDs, a tag ("#namespace:tag"), or a mix of both.

name: Combo Attack Final
description: Checks if the final, bonus-damage attack of a combo attack ability just landed. Stays true for 5 ticks afterwards, so it can be caught by things that only run once per tick.

fields.description: The combo attack ability to check. If not specified, the highest-priority combo attack ability on the entity is used.

name: Customization Selected
description: Checks if the given customization is currently selected by the entity.

fields.description: ID(s) or tag of the required customization.

name: Ground Distance
description: Checks whether the user is on the ground or within max_distance blocks of solid ground directly below them.

fields.description: The maximum distance, in blocks, to the ground below the user.

name: Ability on First Tick
description: Checks if the ability is on its first tick.

fields.description: The ability that needs to be on its first tick.

name: Has Fluid
description: Checks whether the fluid item in the given slot has a stored fluid amount between min and max.

fields.description: Which slot to look for the fluid-storing item in.
The minimum stored fluid amount required.
The maximum stored fluid amount allowed.

name: Ability Animation Timer Value
description: Checks if the given animation timer in an ability has a certain value.

fields.description: The ability that is being checked on.
The minimum required value of the current animation timer value of the ability
The maximum required value of the current animation timer value of the ability

name: Main Hand
description: Checks the player's main-hand handedness setting (not which hand currently holds an item), which is always false for non-player entities.

fields.description: The main hand to check for.

name: Ability Bar Active (Crouch)
description: True while the entity is crouching and this ability is assigned to a crouch slot of the given argon:ability_bar, for abilities that should take over while crouching.

fields.description: Reference to the argon:ability_bar ability whose crouch slot assignments to check, e.g. "fsang:marvel/mutant/reality_warping#my_bar".

name: Nearby Block
description: Checks whether at least one block matching "blocks" exists within "radius" of the user, scanning every block in range on each check.

fields.description: The block(s) to search for, as explicit block IDs, a tag ("#namespace:tag"), or a mix of both.
How far from the user to search.

name: Jumping
description: Checks if the user is currently airborne and moving upward, rather than standing on the ground or descending.

name: Is Female
description: True if the wearer picked "Female" in the argon:body customization. A shorthand for palladium:customization_selected, handy for scoping a body overlay to one chestplate.

name: Guard Broken
description: Checks if the referenced guard ability is currently within its post-break lockout window.

fields.description: The guard ability to check.

name: Slim Armor Model
description: Checks if the entity has the slim armor model (Alex). Returns false if the entity is not a player or if this condition is being checked sever-side.

name: Has Tag
description: Checks if the entity has a specific tag. These tags are added to entities via /tag command.

fields.description: The tag that needs to be on the entity

name: Biome Swap Area
description: Checks whether the user is currently standing inside an active argon:biome_swap area, optionally restricted to one generated with a specific biome.

fields.description: Optional biome a biome_swap area must have been generated with to count, otherwise any active area counts.

name: Is moving
description: Checks if the entity is currently moving.

name: Durability
description: Checks whether the item worn/held in the given slot has remaining durability, as a percentage, between min and max, failing for an empty slot or a non-damageable item.

fields.description: Which slot to check, e.g. an armor slot.
The minimum remaining durability percentage required (0-100).
The maximum remaining durability percentage allowed (0-100).

name: Has Stored Item
description: Checks whether at least one matching item is currently stored in any of the referenced argon:item_storage ability's slots.

fields.description: Reference to the argon:item_storage ability whose stored slots to check, e.g. "fsang:example#my_storage".
The item(s) to search for among the stored slots, given as explicit item IDs, a tag ("#namespace:tag"), or a mix of both.

name: Is Swimming
description: Checks if the entity is swimming.

name: Number Comparison
description: Compares two number values using the given operator.

fields.description: The main value in the comparison
The comparison operator being used
The value that the main value is being compared against

name: True
description: It's just true. That's it.

name: Ability unlocked
description: Checks if the ability is unlocked.

fields.description: The ability that needs to be unlocked

name: Is under Water
description: Checks if the entity is currently under water.

name: Wide Armor Model
description: Checks if the entity has the wide armor model (Steve). Returns false if the entity is not a player or if this condition is being checked sever-side.

name: Is Hardcore
description: Checks if the world is hardcore.

name: OR
description: Allows you to group multiple conditions into one using the OR logic. At least one of the given conditions must be true for this one to be true aswell.

fields.description: List of conditions

name: Difficulty
description: Checks which difficulty the world is on.

fields.description: Difficulty to check.
Checks if the difficulty is also locked.

name: Ability Ticks
description: Checks if the ability has been enabled for a certain amount of ticks.

fields.description: The ability that is being checked on.
The minimum required value of the current tick count of the ability.
The maximum required value of the current tick count of the ability.

name: In Lava
description: Checks if the entity is in lava.

name: MoLang
description: Uses a MoLang query as a condition

name: On Ground
description: Checks if the entity is on the ground.

name: String Comparison
description: Compares two string values using the given operator.

fields.description: The main value in the comparison
The comparison operator being used
The value that the main value is being compared against

name: Ability Bar Active
description: True while this ability is assigned to a slot of the given argon:ability_bar, using the crouch variant (ability_bar_active_crouch) instead if that slot has one and the entity is crouching.

fields.description: Reference to the argon:ability_bar ability whose slot assignments to check, e.g. "fsang:marvel/mutant/reality_warping#my_bar".

name: Brightness at Position
description: Checks if the brightness at the given position is within the given range.

fields.description: The minimum required value of the brightness value (Value between 0-16).
The maximum required value of the brightness value.

name: Ability Enabled Activation
description: Like the vanilla "Ability enabled" condition, but sticky: once the referenced ability is seen enabled, it keeps passing for the given duration after that ability stops.

fields.description: The ability to watch for being enabled.
How long this stays true after the referenced ability was last seen enabled.

name: Item Upgrade
description: Checks if the entity has an equipped item with the given item upgrade installed.

fields.description: ID of the item upgrade to look for.
The slot which is checked for the item upgrade. If empty it looks into the slot of the current context.

name: Entity Scale
description: Checks the current scale of the entity.

fields.description: The minimum required scale of the entity.
The maximum required scale of the entity.

name: Ability Type unlocked
description: Checks if an ability of a certain type is unlocked.

fields.description: The ID(s) or tag(s) of the ability type that needs to be unlocked.

name: Boolean Data Attachment
description: Checks if the value of a boolean data attachment matches the expected value.

fields.description: The ID of the data attachment.
The value that is used if the data attachment is not present.
The value the data attachment must have for the condition to succeed.

name: Multi Jumps Remaining
description: Checks how many extra mid-air jumps a multi jump ability has left before the entity needs to land again. Only available on the server side.

fields.description: The multi jump ability to check.
The minimum amount of remaining jumps.
The maximum amount of remaining jumps.

name: Has Movement Input
description: Checks if a player is currently pressing keys to move.

name: Time Of Day
description: Checks if the overworld's current time of day is between min and max inclusive, wrapping around midnight if max is smaller than min.

fields.description: The start of the time range, in ticks (0 = dawn, 6000 = midday, 12000 = dusk, 18000 = midnight).
The end of the time range, in ticks, wrapping around midnight if smaller than min.

name: Empty Slot
description: Checks if the given slot of an entity is empty

fields.description: The slot that is being looked into.

name: Biome
description: Checks if the user is currently standing in one of the specified biomes.

fields.description: The biome(s) to check for, as explicit biome IDs, a tag ("#namespace:tag"), or a mix of both.

name: Health
description: Checks if the entity has a certain amount of health.

fields.description: The minimum required health of the entity.
The maximum required health of the entity.

name: Beam Firing
description: True while a charged Energy Beam is showing a shot, and for "lead" ticks before its next shot of a multi-shot beam. Use it to raise an arm for each shot.

fields.description: The Energy Beam ability that has a "charge" setting.
How long before the next shot of a multi-shot beam this turns true.
If set, this is only true for this long after each shot instead of for the whole time the shot shows.

name: Took Off
description: True for a short time after an "argon:charged_takeoff" launched the entity. Use it to hand the launch over to a flight ability, e.g. as the enabling of an "argon:force_start_flight".

fields.description: How long after the launch this stays true.

name: Sprinting
description: Checks if the entity is currently sprinting.

name: Nearby Entities
description: Checks whether at least one other entity is within range of the entity, optionally restricted to only living or only non-living entities and/or to entities that do or don't hold specific powers.

fields.description: Which kinds of entities count: 'living' for players/mobs, 'non_living' for everything else.
How far from the entity to search.

Restricts which entities count based on the powers they hold. Each entry lists a "power" (an explicit power id, a power tag ("#namespace:tag"), or a mix of both) and an optional "mode" - "include" (default) requires at least one matching power to be present, "exclude" requires all of them to be absent; an entity only counts if it satisfies every entry. Non-living entities never satisfy an "include" entry. Leave unset (the default) to not filter by power at all.

name: Perspective
description: Checks whether the entity's owning player is in first or third person, synced from the client to the server, defaulting to first-person and always false for non-players.

fields.description: True to check for first person, false to check for third person (front or back).

name: False
description: It's just false. That's it.

name: Has Power
description: Checks whether the user holds a matching power - "include" (default) requires at least one to be present, "exclude" requires all of them to be absent.

fields.description: The power(s) to check for, given as explicit power IDs, a tag ("#namespace:tag"), or a mix of both.
Whether a matching power must be present ("include") or absent ("exclude").

name: Danger Sense Active
description: Checks whether the user has an enabled argon:danger_sense ability that is currently detecting at least one danger - a nearby hostile/aggressive mob, or a player who recently dealt damage to the user.

name: Has Power
description: Checks if the entity has specified power.

fields.description: IDs or tags of power that need to be on the entity.

name: Grappling
description: Checks whether the referenced grapple ability - either argon:grapple or palladium:grapple - is currently grappled to a block, an entity, or either, depending on the configured mode.

fields.description: The grapple ability to check (argon:grapple or palladium:grapple).
Which kind of grapple to check for.

name: Ability Type Enabled Activation
description: Like the vanilla "Ability type enabled" condition, but sticky: once any ability of "ability_type" is seen enabled, it keeps passing for the given duration after they stop.

fields.description: The ability type(s) to watch for being enabled.
How long this stays true after an ability of a matching type was last seen enabled.

name: Advancement
description: Checks whether the user has unlocked a specific advancement, by its id. Server-side only, like advancement data itself - always false on the client, so don't use this from a render_layer's own conditions.

fields.description: The id of the advancement the user must have completed.

name: Is Gliding
description: Checks if the entity is currently gliding/flying with an elytra.

name: Has Energy
description: Checks whether the item in the given slot has stored energy between min and max, with infinite/creative-energy items always passing.

fields.description: Which slot to look for the energy-storing item in.
The minimum stored energy required.
The maximum stored energy allowed.

name: Combo Attack Ready
description: Checks if the next melee attack will be the final, bonus-damage attack of a combo attack ability.

fields.description: The combo attack ability to check. If not specified, the highest-priority combo attack ability on the entity is used.

name: Dimension
description: Tests for the current dimension.

fields.description: ID of the required dimension.

name: Is Flying
description: Checks if the entity is currently flying via any flight type, or is creative flying.

name: Targeted By Mob
description: Checks whether at least one mob within range currently has the user as its AI attack target, by scanning nearby mobs' targets rather than any global registry.

fields.description: How far out to search for mobs that might be targeting the user.

name: Dodge Direction
description: Checks if the referenced dodge ability is showing its dodge pose right now and the dodge went mostly in the given direction relative to where the entity faces. Diagonals count as whichever axis is stronger.

fields.description: The dodge ability to check.
The direction to check.

name: Has Stored Equipment
description: Checks if the store_equipment ability has anything currently stored under the given ID.

fields.description: The ID to check.

name: Item in Slot
description: Checks if the given item is in the given slot

fields.description: Ingredient definition for the required item stack.
The slot that is being looked into.

name: Command Result
description: Executes command(s) and compares the output to a number.

fields.description: The command(s) that are being executed.
The used number operator.
The number it's being compared to.
Whether or not the command result is being logged.

name: Item Open
description: Checks if an item is opened.

fields.description: Slot to check for. If none specified, it will use the slot from the current context (if given).

name: Carrying
description: Checks if the entity is a player currently holding a target via the carry ability.

name: Is on Fire
description: Checks if the entity is currently on fire.

name: In Water
description: Checks if the entity is in water.

name: Has Effect
description: Checks if the entity has a (potion) effect.

fields.description: IDs or tags of the required mob/potion effect

name: As Client Player
description: Evaluates the given conditions against the client player (the player viewing the game) instead of the context entity. Useful for render layers that should only appear based on the viewing player's state. On the server, this condition always returns false.

fields.description: List of conditions to evaluate against the client player

name: Pose
description: Checks if the entity is in a specific pose.

fields.description: The required pose(s).

name: Is Creative Flying
description: Checks if the entity is currently flying in creative mode.

name: Fall Distance
description: Checks how far the entity has fallen since it last touched the ground. Mostly reliable on the server side.

fields.description: The minimum distance in blocks.
The maximum distance in blocks.

name: Ability enabled
description: Checks if the ability is enabled.

fields.description: The ability that needs to be enabled

name: Mode Active
description: Checks if the active mode of a mode switch ability is one of the given mode keys. Returns false in any case if the given ability is locked.

fields.description: The mode switch ability to check.
A mode key, or a list of mode keys, any of which satisfies the condition.
If true, the condition will check the active mode even if the ability is locked. Defaults to false.

name: Crouching
description: Checks if the entity is crouching.

name: Entity Type
description: Checks if the entity is of a specific entity type

fields.description: IDs or tags of the required entity type.

name: Carriable
description: True while you look at something palladium:carry could pick up: any other living entity within "range" blocks. Handy for showing an icon or prompt only when there is a target.

fields.description: How far along the user's look direction to search for a carriable target, in blocks. Left out, it is the referenced argon:carry ability's own range, or 3 blocks without one.

An "argon:carry" ability to check on behalf of, in the form "namespace:power#ability". With it, a target counts only if that ability could grab it: in clear line of sight, not already part of a carry, and allowed by its allow_mobs / allow_players settings. Anything else (or left out) uses Palladium's own carry rules.

name: Attribute
description: Checks and compares the attribute value of the entity.

fields.description: The id of the attribute to check.
Comparison operator being used
Value that is being compared against

name: Multi Jumping
description: Checks if the entity just performed an extra mid-air jump with a multi jump ability. Stays true for 5 ticks afterwards, so it can be used to trigger animations.

fields.description: The multi jump ability to check. If not specified, any multi jump ability on the entity is checked.

name: Item Component
description: Checks whether the item in the given slot has a specific data component currently set to a specific text value.

fields.description: The slot whose item is checked.
The id of the data component to check, e.g. "argon:weapon_mode".
The value the component must currently equal.

name: Sliding
description: Checks if the referenced slide ability is actively sliding right now.

fields.description: The slide ability to check.

name: Is Wall Climbing
description: Checks if the entity is currently wall climbing.

name: Key Press On Block
description: True while the referenced ability's key is held and you look at a block matching "blocks" within "range", e.g. to gate climbing on both the key and a climbable surface.

fields.description: The ability whose key_bind key-press state to check.
The block(s) the user must be looking at, as explicit block IDs, a tag ("#namespace:tag"), or a mix of both.
How far, in blocks, the look-direction raycast reaches.

name: Recently Attacked
description: Checks whether the entity has dealt damage to anything - melee, ranged, or ability-dealt alike - within the given time.

fields.description: How recently the entity must have last attacked something for this to pass.

name: Is using Flight Type
description: Checks if the given entity is currently flying. Optionally checks against specific flight type(s).

fields.description: ID(s) or tag(s) of the required flight type. If omitted, any active flight type passes.

name: Energy Bar
description: Checks if an energy bar has a required amount in it.

fields.description: The energy bar is being looked into.
The minimum required value of the energy bar.
The maximum required value of the energy bar.

fields.description: List of conditions

name: Moon Phase

fields.description: Moon phase(s) that is/are required

fields.description: The movement_speed_adjuster ability whose dial to check.
The lowest dial value this still passes for.
The highest dial value this still passes for.

name: Wall Crawling Active
description: Checks whether the user has an enabled argon:wall_crawling ability that is currently attached to a wall or ceiling - true only while actually on a surface, not just whenever the ability is enabled.

name: Wears Suit Set
description: Checks if the entity is wearing the specified suit set

fields.description: ID of the needed suit set

name: Is in Water or Rain
description: Checks if the entity is currently in water or rain.

name: Ability on Cooldown
description: Checks if the ability is currently on cooldown. If the power is not null, it will look for the ability in the specified power. If the power is null, it will look for the ability in the current power.

fields.description: The ability that is being checked on.

name: Gamemode
description: Checks if the player is in the specified gamemode.

fields.description: Gamemode to check.

name: Saturation
description: Checks if the user's saturation level is at least the given amount, always false for non-player entities.

fields.description: The minimum saturation level required.

name: Carrying
description: True while the entity is holding something with argon:carry. Unlike palladium:carrying, which only sees palladium:carry, this works for any living carrier, not just players.

name: Ability Type enabled
description: Checks if an ability of a certain type is enabled.

fields.description: The ID(s) or tag(s) of the ability type that needs to be enabled.

name: Night
description: Check if it's currently nighttime

name: Dodging
description: Checks if the referenced dodge ability is actively showing its dodge pose right now.

fields.description: The dodge ability to check.

name: Objective Score
description: Checks if the player has a score in a specific objective.

fields.description: Name of the scoreboard objective.

Maximum required score value.

name: AND
description: Allows you to group multiple conditions into one using the AND logic. All of the given conditions must be true for this one to be true aswell.

fields.description: List of conditions

name: Advancement
description: Checks if the player has completed a specific advancement.

fields.description: The namespace and ID(s) of the advancement(s) to check. All listed advancements must be completed.

name: Carried
description: True while the entity is being held by someone else's "argon:carry" ability (the carrier's side is the "argon:carrying" condition). It works for any living entity that can be carried.

description: True while the referenced argon:flight_speed_adjuster dial sits within min-max (inclusive). The flight counterpart of argon:movement_speed_percent.

The highest dial value that passes (inclusive). Unset means no upper limit.
